BiblicalUsage: hâlâʼ turns up where the Bible says to cast far off, to remove. In Micah 4:7, the text says "and her that was cast far off a strong nation."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hâlâʼ means to cast far off, to remove, and I leave it at that.
